title: Using the dashboard | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Use and customise the dashboard
hero.lead: The dashboard combines the most important information and direct actions for the signed-in account from calendars, teams, communication and reports.

body:
What appears on the dashboard

After sign-in, Kaderblick opens the dashboard with a personal greeting. Open quick actions and your saved widgets appear below it.

✅
Quick response
Players and coaches can answer a prioritised attendance or help-out request directly when a matching open action exists.
📄
Outstanding training records
For a matching relationship, a notice opens the missing record directly and may show its name and due date.
🧩
Personal widgets
Calendar, messages, news, upcoming appointments, birthdays and reports can be arranged as separate blocks.

Add a widget

  1. 1
    Open the selection
    Select Add widget at the top.
  2. 2
    Choose the widget type
    Choose Calendar, Messages, News, Upcoming appointments, Birthdays or Statistics widget.
  3. 3
    Choose statistics
    For a Statistics widget, select an existing report or start the simple wizard or detailed builder.
  4. 4
    Check the result
    The new widget appears on the dashboard and a success message confirms it.

If no widget exists yet

On an empty dashboard, use the offered entry points or Add widget to set up the required content.

Use widgets

ActionEffectImportant
RefreshReloads this widget’s data.Other widgets remain unchanged.
SettingsOpens options such as size or content configuration.Fields depend on the widget type.
Edit reportOpens the report configuration for a statistics widget.Only available for suitable report widgets.
RemoveRemoves the block after confirmation.The underlying calendar, report or content is not deleted.
MoveChanges widget order.Drag the widget by its handle to the new position.

Set width and calendar view

  1. Open the widget’s gear-shaped Settings.
  2. Choose narrow, normal, half, large or full width.
  3. For a calendar, also choose Day, Week or Month.
  4. The offset moves the displayed period relative to today into the past or future.
  5. Apply with Save.

Remove a widget

Select the bin icon. The confirmation dialog names the widget. Select Delete to remove it from the dashboard or Cancel.

Widget types

Calendar

Shows appointments visible to your account. Use its view and navigation actions for an overview. Create and fully edit appointments in Calendar.

Upcoming appointments

Shows the next appointments loaded for your account in chronological order.

News

Shows current posts from your visible club and team contexts. Open an entry to read the full post.

Messages

Shows current conversations or entry points. Use the Messages area for complete communication.

Birthdays

Shows the birthdays made available to your account.

Reports and statistics

Shows a saved report visualisation. The pencil Edit report opens its configuration. If a regular member edits a template, Kaderblick saves a personal copy; administrators can edit templates directly.

Respond to attendance directly

Players and coaches may see a response above the widgets. Read the complete appointment and context before accepting, declining or choosing another option. The saved answer also appears in the connected appointment and matchday views.

Complete an outstanding training record

If the dashboard shows a missing record, select Upload record. In the opened team view, check the player, due date and required document before uploading a file.

Role-dependent quick actions

  • Players and coaches: Quick attendance responses load for accounts with a player or coach relationship.
  • Players: If an available training record is missing for the linked player profile, the next due record appears with Upload record.

Resolve problems

A widget has no data

  1. Refresh that widget.
  2. Check the underlying area for matching data and filters.
  3. Check the club, team, player or coach assignment.
  4. Check the displayed period and context.

No existing report in the statistics dialog

Create one there with Simple wizard or Detailed builder. After saving, the new statistics widget is added to the dashboard.
